name: The God Hakkar
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Now it is time to capture the essence of the avatar of Hakkar.

Take the Egg of Hakkar to the Sanctum of the Fallen God in the Sunken Temple in Azeroth.  Invoke the egg's power to stir the dead god.

He will send his minions against you.  Defeat his bloodrinkers and take their Hakkari blood, then use the blood to dowse the eternal flames that hold Hakkar's spirit.  When all the flames go out, the avatar of Hakkar will enter our world.

Defeat him, and place his essence within the egg of Hakkar.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Filled Egg of Hakkar to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.
narrative.offerRewardText:
The essence of Hakkar has been collected! Even now the Egg stirs with life! Could the myths of Hakkar be true?

That must not be true, for it is then I fear what Hakkar may do if birthed again. I will keep this egg safe and be sure it does not fall into evil hands.

Your labors with me are finished, adventurer. You have touched a legend, and your actions may one day change the face of our world.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you defeated the avatar of Hakkar, adventurer? Has his essence yet empowered the egg I gave you?
